summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Cohere SDK integration setup with specific version constraints (>=5.4.0) and AgentOps configuration workflow. It does not semantically match existing skills: OpenTelemetry is a macro_protocol for general observability instrumentation (different asset_type and stage), and Maven Setup is for Java project configuration (different domain and task_family). Peer candidates (LiteLLM, CamelAI, AgentOps Environment Setup) are sibling integration skills at the same layer, not existing overlaps. The candidate has support evidence from official AgentOps documentation and introduces a new, non-conflicting capability.
